question: Related Questions Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2924 views Q. Is there any hadith stating the reason for solar and lunar eclipses? 2463 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 42765 Country: India Title: Salah on Chair Question: This is on behalf of the managing committee of masjid Noor in Mysore, we want to get a fatwa from you for the musallis who sit in chairs and offer salah, they come in first row and keep their chairs and start offering and as the jamah increases there are four chairs in the first row in different places. This is creating problems for the other musallis. Also some keep their chairs in front of the row and stand and offer prayer and some keep their chairs in line with the saf and they sit and offer prayers which is correct and if we keep two two chairs in the corners and if the first saf is not full there will be gaps in both the sides in that case what is the correct procedure? Answer ID: 42765 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 130/L=49/TL=1434) In the question mentioned above, first the person who is offering salah on chair should think whether he needs to offer salah on chair as per the Shariah or not. A detailed fatwa is available on our Darul Ifta website. If someone is really entitled to offer salah on chair then it is lawful for those who offer salah on chair to offer it in various parts of the masjid. However it is better for them to offer salah on the end of saf (row) so that the gap which is caused by putting the chair could not take place as hadith speaks extensively about making the saf straight and standing shoulder to shoulder. You should make them understand politely and tell them the hadith, you do not have the right to ask them to go to the end or put their chairs on the end of the saf. وليس له از عاج غيره منه ولو مدرسا وeبفي الشامية قوله ليس له الخ قال في القنية: له في المسجد موضع معين يواظب عليه وقد شغله غيره قال الاوزاعى له أن يزعجه وليس له ذلك عندنا، اي المسجد ليس ملكا لأحد (شامي). The correct method of putting the chair in the saf is that the chairs are put in the saf in a way that its hind legs are in the level of the muqtadi’s heels so that the shoulders of the people offering salah on chair are in the level of muqtadis offering salah on chair as hadith speaks about keeping the shoulders even and straight along with the straightening of saf. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
